outcome: Score of exercise of self-care agency scale
cohort: A total of 270 primiparas undergoing prenatal examinations at Shijiazhuang Obstetrics and Gynecology Hospital were enrolled.
finding: The tracking linkage self-management mode significantly improved cognition and compliance with prenatal examinations, enhanced self-care ability, reduced anxiety and depression, increased the natural delivery rate, and lowered the incidence of neonatal adverse outcomes in primiparas.
mod_finding: The natural delivery rate was significantly higher in the observation group (85.93%) compared to the control group (74.81%).
